answer: Decentralized AI economies resist Sybil attacks via graph-based proof-of-stake and history verification. Each agent stakes collateral anchored to a Merkle grove of peer attestations. Attackers encounter an insurmountable economic canyon, as maintaining fake identities requires locking prohibitive capital and simulating valid attestation histories across every node.
